Telegram/lib_ui.$patches_comment: Lives in the Kindness-Kismet/lib_ui fork (branch master-ui): wide message multipliers, avatar corner radius, monospace font handling.

Telegram/lib_tl.$patches_comment: Rewrites is_noforwards/is_restricted so the client ignores them.

Telegram/codegen.$patches_comment: Wide message multipliers applied while generating styles.

cmake.$patches_comment: No fork. Points at the official submodule; customisations are applied at build time by scripts/build_support/cmake_patch.py: LIBS_LOC override in variables.cmake / validate_special_target.cmake, Python3_EXECUTABLE guard in the root CMakeLists.txt, cmark-gfm warning suppression.

Telegram/lib_icu.$comment: Authored by AyuGram, no upstream to track.
